caption:
The Moon hid Saturn in early 2025. It can happen again in 2031.

An occultation is when the Moon moves in front of Saturn.
This NASA picture is different. Cassini watched the moon Enceladus sink behind Saturn in 2017.
The APOD showed a dot by Saturn. It was a star, 85 Aquarii, far behind the planet.

What the astronomers say: Only a strip of Earth saw it, from Greenland to northern Africa.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA21889. Cassini, Enceladus and Saturn, 2017.
